row.title: Slice S08-foundation-tests-1 of the specification work shipped on its own
row.body: Foundation tests for specification requirements 0, 1, 3, 26, 27 and 28. A test that compares specification text with code reads it from ULTRASTABLE_SPEC_DIR and skips in public CI where the specification is private. One cohesive set inside the 60 file and 3,000 line bound.
